title: [GAP-14] No IANA / registry considerations
description: Review finding GAP-14: No IANA / registry considerations (lens GAP). Location: spec/10-relays.md:46, 176-178, 208-214; spec/11-transport.md:303; spec/13-encoding.md:64; spec/09-interop.md:30-36; spec/03-spaces.md:33. Fix: As proposed. There is no hit for "IANA". 13:100 says "No registry is needed", but that covers type URIs only. One strengthening: RFC 9420 §17 defines IANA registries for MLS Credential Types and MLS Exporter Labels, so `AgoraMIMICredential` and the exporter labels ("agora access", "agora channel token", "agora sealed envelope", "agora blob", "agora-dm-token", and others) each need a registry entry, not only a central list. `urn:agora:` stays excluded per decision. Full text: notes/review/GAP-verified.md and notes/review/GAP.md.
